items.title: Systems of record have never been more important than in a world where you have…
items.summaryText:
Systems of record have never been more important than in a world where you have AI agents that will do 100X more work on these platforms than people ever did. 

Agents will be querying the data in these systems, processing tasks, executing workflows, collaborating with human and agent users, and more. 

Thus, the governance, reliability, security, access controls, and business logic remain critical more than ever — the OpenAI Hugging Face incident is just a small peek into what the future will look like with agents running around trying to execute on their goals.

But this only works for the systems of record that respond with the right product experiences, APIs, and business models to support agents on and off their platform executing in these systems.

Huge moment of opportunity and disruption right now in all of software.

metadata.bio: ceo @box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI

items.summaryZh:
记录系统从未像现在这样重要，因为在这个世界里，AI 代理在这些平台上所做的工作量将比人类以往多出 100 倍。

代理将查询这些系统中的数据、处理任务、执行工作流、与人类和代理用户协作等等。

因此，治理、可靠性、安全性、访问控制和业务逻辑比以往任何时候都更加关键——OpenAI Hugging Face 事件只是对未来景象的一瞥：代理四处运行，试图实现它们的目标。

但这只对那些以正确的产品体验、API 和商业模式来响应、支持代理在平台内外执行任务的记录系统才有效。

当下是整个软件领域充满机遇和颠覆的巨大时刻。

items.title: Tomorrow we will bring back the 5h limit for Plus accounts across ChatGPT Work a…
items.summaryText:
Tomorrow we will bring back the 5h limit for Plus accounts across ChatGPT Work and Codex. I had mentioned this a while ago, but then postponed it.

This is necessary as (a) the 5h limit allows us to smoothen the load on our compute, allowing to keep the plan generous in terms of weekly usage and (b) users on the Plus plan are relatively casual and new users, but then also just accidentally eat through their whole weeks usage and then are confused, making it not a great experience.

We are for the upcoming months keeping the 5h limit not enabled for Pro $100 and Pro $200 subscriptions.

metadata.bio: Codex & ChatGPT @OpenAI

明天我们将在 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 中恢复 Plus 账户的 5 小时限制。我之前提到过这一点，但后来又推迟了。

items.title:
How to build great evals - part 8.

The discriminatory property of evals.
A hill…
items.summaryText:
How to build great evals - part 8.

The discriminatory property of evals.
A hill-climbing eval is useful when it can separate AI systems that are meaningfully different.

Imagine you run an eval on five AI systems:

A: 94
B: 93
C: 95
D: 94
E: 92

Now suppose you already know A and C are substantially better systems than D and E.

The eval is bad cos it doesn’t tell you that. It has low discriminatory power.

It’s like giving a fifth-grade math test to a group of PhDs - everyone aces it and  you’ve learned nothing about who is the smartest.

That doesn’t mean making evals arbitrarily hard. Then everyone fails and you’re not measuring what your systems are meant for.

The sweet spot for an eval is:
Realistic + difficult + sensitive to differences in capability.

Over time, your good evals will saturate as your harness and underlying models improve. What do you do then?

Drop your guesses in the comments.

Share this with your teammates.

metadata.bio: Sr Director, AI at Meta; Prev: Google - Led Gemini, Veo, Nano Banana.

items.summaryZh:
如何构建优秀的评估——第 8 部分。

评估的区分性。
当评估能够区分真正不同的 AI 系统时，它就是一个有用的爬山式评估。

想象你在五个 AI 系统上运行一个评估：

A: 94
B: 93
C: 95
D: 94
E: 92

现在假设你已知 A 和 C 比 D 和 E 明显更好。

这个评估很糟糕，因为它没有告诉你这一点。它的区分能力很低。

就像给一群博士做五年级数学测试——每个人都能得满分，而你完全看不出谁最聪明。

这并不意味着要让评估任意地难。那样的话所有人都不及格，你就无法衡量你的系统本应具备的能力。

评估的最佳点是：
真实 + 困难 + 对能力差异敏感。

随着时间推移，你的优秀评估会饱和，因为你的测试框架和底层模型在改进。那时你会怎么做？

在评论区留下你的猜测。

分享给你的队友。

items.title: If your terminal ever gets into a 'bad state', like garbled outputs, you run 𝚛�…
items.summaryText:
If your terminal ever gets into a 'bad state', like garbled outputs, you run 𝚛𝚎𝚜𝚎𝚝. I noticed it was… oddly slow.

Turns out in 1979 3BSD's 𝚝𝚜𝚎𝚝 had a 𝚜𝚕𝚎𝚎𝚙(𝟷) to let mechanical printer-and-ink terminals 'settle down' 😂

I asked 𝚏𝚡 to write me a faster alternative in Zig. It takes 1ms instead of 1s. It was really cool to dive deeper into 𝚗𝚌𝚞𝚛𝚜𝚎𝚜, 𝚝𝚜𝚎𝚝, 𝚝𝚎𝚛𝚖𝚒𝚗𝚏𝚘, and the myriad ways in which your terminal can get… cursed.

It's legit fascinating how far back our technology stack goes, and how enduring good system design is, even with the occasional 'spider webs' you can find.

Check out https://t.co/7EH0lothku for a fun explainer (and some alternative solutions.)

ps: once you start using 𝚏𝚡, you'll notice slowness like this everywhere :D

metadata.bio: @vercel CEO

items.summaryZh:
如果你的终端进入‘糟糕状态’，比如输出乱码，你会运行 𝚛𝚎𝚜𝚎𝚝。我注意到它……出奇地慢。

原来在 1979 年，3BSD 的 𝚝𝚜𝚎𝚝 中有一个 𝚜𝚕𝚎𝚎𝚙(𝟷)，目的是让机械式打印机和墨水终端‘稳定下来’ 😂

我让 𝚏𝚡 用 Zig 给我写一个更快的替代品。它只需要 1ms，而不是 1s。深入研究 𝚗𝚌𝚞𝚛𝚜𝚎𝚜、𝚝𝚜𝚎𝚝、𝚝𝚎𝚛𝚖𝚒𝚗𝚏𝚘，以及你的终端可能被‘诅咒’的无数种方式，真的非常酷。

我们的技术栈可以追溯到多么久远，这确实令人着迷；好的系统设计又是多么持久，即使偶尔会发现一些‘蜘蛛网’。

请查看 https://t.co/7EH0lothku 获取有趣的解释（以及一些替代方案）。

附：一旦你开始使用 𝚏𝚡，你会发现到处都是这种慢 :D

items.title: It’s not fully appreciated that ZDR is responsible for a substantial amount of t…
items.summaryText:
It’s not fully appreciated that ZDR is responsible for a substantial amount of the growth of AI, because it dramatically simplified the compliance process most companies deal with in handling data with subprocessors. The alternative path would have been a far slower adoption rate.

For the applied AI tools that are primarily responsible for driving AI growth, they generally have agreements in place with their customers to only offer models with ZDR to ensure that customers don’t have to inspect each model they turn on. Anything else is an exception process that takes far longer.

And then inside enterprises directly, most companies have internal governance requirements that say they can only use ZDR models because they have no way of explicitly separating PII and other sensitive or confidential data they put in the context window across their enterprise.

Now, all of this could change if the entire industry went this direction, but with one off models hold outs it would take years for these policies to change. Without ZDR, AI diffusion grinds to a halt.

metadata.bio: ceo @box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI

items.summaryZh:
人们还没有充分认识到，ZDR 对 AI 的大量增长负有重大责任，因为它极大地简化了大多数公司在使用子处理者处理数据时所面临的合规流程。若非如此，采用速度将会慢得多。

对于主要负责推动 AI 增长的应用型 AI 工具，它们通常与客户达成协议，只提供带有 ZDR 的模型，以确保客户无需检查他们启动的每一个模型。其他一切都需要经历耗时长得多的例外流程。

然后，在企业内部，大多数公司都有内部治理要求，规定只能使用 ZDR 模型，因为它们无法明确地将 PII 以及它们在整个企业的上下文窗口中放入的其他敏感或机密数据分离开来。

现在，如果整个行业都朝这个方向发展，这一切都可能改变；但只要有少数一次性模型作为例外拒不跟进，这些政策就需要数年时间才能改变。没有 ZDR，AI 的扩散将戛然而止。
